name: Toast
description: Imperative, announced feedback with semantic variants, optional actions, and dismissal.

anatomy.description: Fixed container mounted once near the app root; stacks incoming toasts and owns their live region.
The announced surface carrying the message; auto-dismisses after its duration unless made persistent.
Decorative severity glyph matched to the neutral, info, success, warning, or danger variant.
The message text; the title is required and the description carries detail.
An optional action button plus a labeled dismiss control.

dos: Mount exactly one Toaster near the app root so every toast() call shares it.
Match the variant to the outcome, such as success for a completed save.
Pass duration: Infinity for messages the user must not miss, and pair them with an action.
donts: Don't toast information the user must act on later; use Alert or Banner so it stays in context.
Don't fire several toasts for one operation; collapse retries into a single final message.
Don't put long copy in a toast; keep the title to a phrase and move detail into the description.

examples.title: Saving feedback
examples.description: Call toast() from anywhere once a Toaster is mounted near the app root.

examples.title: Failure feedback
examples.description: Use a danger variant for a failed action and keep the recovery path in context.

examples.title: Undo feedback
examples.description: Offer a short action when users may want to reverse a completed operation.

guidance.useWhen: A completed or failed action needs brief asynchronous feedback.
guidance.avoidWhen: The message is required to continue or must be read in context.
guidance.behavior: Toaster announces messages and supports timed or manual dismissal.
guidance.responsive: Position toasts away from mobile browser controls and safe areas.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the toast viewport so toasts can be reviewed and dismissed.
Dismisses a toast on touch devices.

notes: Toasts are announced through a live region as they appear.
Actions render as real buttons with accessible labels.
Pass duration: Infinity for critical messages that must be dismissed manually.
